texts.title: Office Kitchen
texts.content:
Kitchen Reminder: New Cleaning Policy
Our office kitchen has become very crowded, and some food has been left in the refrigerator for weeks.
Starting next Monday, please follow these simple rules:
Label all food with your name and the date.
Every Friday at 4 P.M., the cleaning staff will throw away anything left in the refrigerator, labeled or not.
Wash and put away your own dishes; the sink is not a storage area.
The coffee machine is cleaned on Wednesday mornings and cannot be used before 10 A.M. that day.
Thanks for helping keep our shared space clean.
— Office Management

options: A. To explain new rules for a shared space
B. To introduce new cleaning staff
C. To announce a new coffee machine
D. To invite employees to a Friday party
questions.explanation: It says the kitchen "has become very crowded" and introduces "these simple rules" for the shared space.

questions.stem: What will happen to a labeled lunch left in the refrigerator on Friday evening?
options: A. It will be moved to the sink.
B. It will be thrown away.
C. It will be kept until Monday.
D. It will be returned to its owner.
questions.explanation: "Every Friday at 4 P.M., the cleaning staff will throw away anything left in the refrigerator, labeled or not."

questions.explanation: The machine "is cleaned on Wednesday mornings and cannot be used before 10 A.M. that day."
